use default

let dots = ["    ", " o  ", " oo ", "ooo ", "oooo"]
let bar = "===="

vigesimal(n: int) -> List[int] is
    let digits = LIST[int]()
    let rest mut = n

    do
        digits.insert(0, rest % 20)
        rest = rest / 20

        if rest == 0 then break fi
    od

    digits
si

glyph(digit: int) -> string[] is
    let rows = ["    ", "    ", "    ", "    "] |> collect_list()

    if digit == 0 then
        rows[3] = " @  "
    else
        let bars = digit / 5

        for b in 0..bars do
            rows[3 - b] = bar
        od

        if digit % 5 > 0 then
            rows[3 - bars] = dots[digit % 5]
        fi
    fi

    rows |> collect_array()
si

cartouche(n: int) -> List[string] is
    let glyphs = vigesimal(n) |> map(glyph) |> collect_list()
    let across = glyphs |> map(_ => "----") |> collect_list()

    let lines = LIST(["+{across |> join("+")}+"])

    for row in 0..4 do
        lines.add("|{glyphs |> map(g => g[row]) |> join("|")}|")
    od

    lines.add("+{across |> join("+")}+")

    lines
si

for n in [4005, 8017, 326205, 886205, 3199999] do
    write_line("{n:N0} is {vigesimal(n) |> join(".")} in base 20:")
    cartouche(n) |> each(line => write_line("  {line}"))

write_line("3,199,999 is the largest number five glyphs can write,")
